title: Slovenia & Croatia
introTitle: Two branch visits in one day.
intro: The day begins in Kamnik with a visit to the Slovenia Bethel Branch office. From there, the route crosses into Croatia for a visit to the Croatia Bethel Branch Office in Zagreb before turning north again and returning to Kamnik for the night.
